searchText: Toronto is where ETH was proposed, if we’re going for city names I’d suggest the city where ETH was invented. Fair. I was looking to be symbolic of a “merge.” Some are suggesting we start naming as stars instead of cities with 2.0. Not a bad idea. I mostly mention Toronto due to Canadian pride ✌🏻 If we're going for stars it's hard to come up with something better than "V1309 Scorpii"
